note: The /get page's shot list. tools/refresh_get.py films each entry in `films` with tools/film_run.py, finds each clip's `moment` in the film's timeline, and cuts it. Edit this, not tools/get_clips.json (that one is written from this). One run film per Experience, so the page shows several worlds. A clip's "film" may be a list: the first film the moment happened in, or with "each": true the moment from every one in turn ("max_each" caps each one's seconds). "hide_characters" are left out of every film's roster copy. A film's "kit" (a JSON list of items, plates in the repo) goes into the played character's pack copy, in order. Moments: opening, create (every character made on camera), key, last_fight, hardest_fight, move, typed (the ACT turns typed from act_lines), wear (a fitting in the pack; "all": every fitting in the film), goal (walk to it, the reward, the take). `lead`/`tail` widen a moment (seconds); `hold` is how much of any still stretch is kept; `poster_at` is where in the finished clip the poster is taken (0-1); `sub` is the small line under the word (default: the world and who; false for none). `pick` overrides a choice: {"turn": 10} for move, {"fight": 2}, {"typed": 2}, {"wear": 2}. A film list entry can be {"film": "swat", "pick": {"typed": 2}}, so one clip can take the same film twice, in the order written. typed and create lay the words that were typed over the top of the picture, typed out.
